question: The SI unit of temperature is/are _________
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

The SI (International System of Units) unit of temperature is the "kelvin" (symbol: K). The kelvin is the base unit of thermodynamic temperature in the SI system and is defined by fixing the numerical value of the Boltzmann constant, *k*, to 1.380649 × 10⁻²³ when expressed in the unit J·K⁻¹, which is equal to kg·m²·s⁻²&middo
